structured.reason: Switching to trust_env=True makes the async client pick up proxy variables (HTTP(S)_PROXY, ALL_PROXY), .netrc credentials and SSL environment settings. Chat and upload traffic could then be sent through another proxy or carry injected auth instead of going straight to the configured QwenChat proxy base_url. That breaks the "proxy HTTP behavior" and transport-boundary behavior that TREQ_QWENCHAT_ADAPTER_BOUNDARY requires.
structured.test_focus: Set HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY/ALL_PROXY to an unreachable proxy and run aexecute (with a media upload). Check that both the upload and chat requests still reach the configured base_url directly and succeed, e.g. by asserting the AsyncClient is created with trust_env=False.
